newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end off on worries about the economy.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end off on worries about the economy.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed down, led by selling of Telebras, as investors dumped local shares due to concern over Brazil's growing trade and current account deficits, brokers said.
"What I'm seeing is growing interest in dollar futures and less interest in stocks," one dealer said. "The market is worried about the economy, especially the trade and current account gaps."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of 49 most traded shares dropped 596 points, or 0.91 percent, to close at 65,233 points.
